skills.name: pixelcraft
skills.purpose: Orchestrates distinctive, evidence-verified UI work across any frontend stack.

skills.name: pixelcraft-plan
skills.purpose: Plans greenfield and brownfield UI work, selects platforms and technology stacks, and produces the .pixelcraft/plan.md consumed by later Pixelcraft skills.

skills.name: pixelcraft-direction
skills.purpose: Generates distinctive visual direction without template collapse.

skills.name: pixelcraft-craft
skills.purpose: Applies high-craft visual design decisions across platforms.

skills.name: pixelcraft-tokens
skills.purpose: Creates and exports cross-platform design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens Community Group 2025.10 format.

skills.name: pixelcraft-ux
skills.purpose: Designs rigorous user experience before and during implementation.

skills.name: pixelcraft-patterns
skills.purpose: Applies surface-independent product UX patterns without collapsing into generic templates.

skills.name: pixelcraft-dataviz
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies truthful, legible, accessible data visualization across any frontend stack.

skills.name: pixelcraft-accessibility
skills.purpose: Applies and verifies the accessibility floor across platforms.

skills.name: pixelcraft-brandkit
skills.purpose: Creates premium brand-kit and identity-board image generation briefs for brand kits, logo systems, brand guidelines, moodboards, identity decks, visual-world presentations, launch identities, logo concepts, palette/type systems, and implementation-ready brand direction.

skills.name: pixelcraft-web
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into idiomatic web UI across HTML/CSS, React/Next, Vue/Nuxt, Svelte, Solid, Angular, Astro, Qwik, htmx/Alpine, Lit, Tailwind, server-rendered stacks, Rust/Leptos/Yew, Kotlin web, Elm, ClojureScript, F#/Fable, Scala/Laminar, and Java web.

skills.name: pixelcraft-mobile
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into idiomatic mobile UI across SwiftUI, UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, React Native/Expo, Kotlin Multiplatform, Ionic/Capacitor, .NET MAUI, Flet, and Kivy.

skills.name: pixelcraft-data-apps
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into data applications, AI/ML demos, dashboards, notebooks, BI reports, and internal tools in any language.

skills.name: pixelcraft-desktop
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into desktop applications across Tauri, Electron, Qt/PySide/QML, WinUI/WPF, AppKit, GTK, Avalonia, Rust GUI, Java desktop, C++ GUI, Go GUI, and Uno Platform.

skills.name: pixelcraft-tui
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into terminal user interfaces across Textual, Rich, Ink, Bubble Tea/Lip Gloss, and Ratatui.

skills.name: pixelcraft-extensions
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies host-constrained extension and plugin interfaces.

skills.name: pixelcraft-game-ui
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into game interfaces across Unity UI Toolkit, Godot Control/UI, Unreal UMG, LÖVE2D, Bevy, and MonoGame.

skills.name: pixelcraft-spatial
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies embodied spatial, XR, VR, and AR interfaces across visionOS, WebXR, Meta Quest Interaction SDK, and Unity XR Interaction Toolkit.

skills.name: pixelcraft-constrained
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies interfaces for constrained or nonstandard surfaces: TV/console/10-foot UI, D-pad/gamepad spatial navigation, watchOS/Wear OS wearables, e-ink displays, kiosks/self-service hardware, embedded LVGL/low-resolution screens, automotive CarPlay/Android Auto templates, and basic voice UI.

skills.name: pixelcraft-email
skills.purpose: Translates Pixelcraft direction, tokens, UX, and floor requirements into email that survives real clients.

skills.name: pixelcraft-document
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies paginated documents, print output, reports, invoices, CVs, and slide decks across web and document tooling.

skills.name: pixelcraft-media
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies social cards, Open Graph/Twitter images, repository banners, SVG posters, video frames, and motion graphics for external platforms.

skills.name: pixelcraft-chat-ui
skills.purpose: Designs and verifies conversational and messaging-platform interfaces across Slack Block Kit, Discord components/embeds/modals, Telegram bots and Mini Apps, Zalo Mini Apps/ZaUI, WhatsApp interactive messages, and Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards.

skills.name: pixelcraft-review
skills.purpose: Audits, critiques, and polishes UI with evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: pixelcraft-visual-qa
skills.purpose: Verifies interfaces through rendered evidence using a render → screenshot → self-critique → fix loop.

skills.name: pixelcraft-handoff
skills.purpose: Translates approved designs, Figma selections, screenshots, mockups, and design-system artifacts into faithful implementation without losing existing architecture.
